reason: I count price per day, and $0.83 to $1 a day for magnesium is way more than a big bottle at the store. I also forget my vitamins half the time, so a box of 30 would probably sit on the counter.
objection: It is two capsules every day for a price I can beat with a bottle of magnesium, and I would not stick with it anyway.
would_change_my_mind: A price around $15 for the 30 days, or a bigger flash-sale discount, plus a single capsule instead of two.
